scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --strict-vars=false >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p src/recorder && tsc --noEmit -p src/player && tsc --noEmit -p src/survey
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply AUTH_DB --local
scripts.deploy: echo 'Deploy from the repo root: pnpm afs deploy <profile> replay  (see docs/self-hosting.md)' && exit 1
